title: ELTE-TCM-46k: A CNC Tool Condition Image Dataset
authors: Alireza Falah, Soninkhuu Baatarchuluun, Mátyás Andó, Béla Szekeres
description: A dataset of approximately 46,000 high-resolution TIFF images of CNC cutting tools, created to support research in automated Tool Condition Monitoring (TCM). It is a valuable resource for machine vision tasks like classification, segmentation, and anomaly detection in smart manufacturing.

title: Autonomous Racing: A2RL Competition
description: Contributed to the team's 5th place global finish by executing critical simulation-based verification of vehicle behavior. I utilized the official simulator to validate control strategies and ensure stability prior to track deployment.
